texts.zh:
探索新获得的灵能能力对[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的共情能力造成了根本性的转变。

很显然，我们现在能对其他意识的观点、思维模式和情感进行比以前复杂得多的建模。这些变化对[owner.GetName]究竟意味着新的优势还是劣势，还有待观察。
texts.en:
The exploration of our newfound psionic abilities has resulted in fundamental changes to [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] empathetic capacities.

It is already clear that we are now capable of much more sophisticated modelling of the perspectives, thought patterns, and emotions of other consciousnesses than before. Whether these changes represent a new strength or weakness for the [owner.GetName] remains to be seen.

texts.zh:
随着我们的人口正在探索新的灵能能力，一个新的社群建立了起来，旨在将其用于对其他意识更广泛的共情理解。

该集体声称，由于新出现的灵能感知力，他们能够高度复杂地模拟其他人的观点、思维模式和情感。他们的这种活动对[owner.GetName]究竟是好是坏仍有待观察。
texts.en:
As our population explores their newfound psionic capacities, a new community has been established with the goal of applying them towards greater empathetic understanding of other consciousnesses.

This collective professes to be capable of highly sophisticated modelling of the perspectives, thought patterns, and emotions of other minds thanks to their emergent psionic senses. Whether their activities will ultimately benefit or undermine the [owner.GetName] remains to be seen.

label.en: This is a chance to learn.
